notes: «قال أبو داود رواه ابن المبارك أخبرنا فليح سمعت عباس بن سهل يحدث» names a different transmitter (Ibn al-Mubarak, Fulayh) for the same saying: a variant group, never a route.
«أراه ذكر عيسى بن عبد الله» is Abu Dawud's uncertain recall of his own source and «حضرت أبا حميد» is his own presence; neither is written as a link.
«بهذا الحديث» names the saying, not an isnad, so it is not a back_reference.
